profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Datadog | ex-Uber | ex-Jet
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Backend engineer specializing in distributed systems and data-intensive applications. 
I design and build high-throughput services and data pipelines across streaming and batch with predictable, low-latency behavior. 
Experience spans real-time systems, event-driven processing, and analytics used in observability, cost, security, and more. 
I focus on scale, performance, and reliability, helping teams deliver durable systems that are easy to operate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Building and scaling Datadog's core data platform for infrastructure resources and relationships, including offline export systems and reliability measurement, enabling insights into performance, cost, security, observability, and more.

Driving distributed ingestion, query, and analytics systems that make constantly changing datasets accessible with SQL-style simplicity and low-latency performance.
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Platform Architecture and +21 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Worked on the Marketplace Health team for Uber Eats, focused on real-time marketplace monitoring and operational controls.

Delivered backend services that provided global operations with better visibility into supply, demand, and health metrics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · On-site
positions.description:
Built distributed systems in Jet’s transportation and warehouse management domains.

Leveraged DDD, CQRS, and Event Sourcing with a microservices architecture to deliver scalable, resilient, and highly available systems.

Worked with technologies including Azure (Cosmos DB, Queues, Tables), EventStore, SQL Server, Kafka, and F#.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the Informed Traveler Program and Applications (ITPA) project to improve public transportation in South Florida.
Developed transit applications and APIs to enhance commuter experience and operational visibility.

certifications.name: Cisco CCNA II - Router and Routing Basic
certifications.title: Cisco CCNA II - Router and Routing Basic

honors.title: 2nd Place Participant
honors.issuer: Issued by ACM-ICPC International Collegiate Programming Contest · Oct 2010

projects.title: Manimap (HackIllinois 2016)
projects.description: Private map channel system where users can tag points of interest and invite others to their channels. Google Maps, AngularJS, Android, Firebase

projects.title: Moodsical (MangoHack 2016)
projects.description:
-	Mobile app that suggested Spotify playlists by user’s personality and emotion with Watson and Naïve Bayes classifiers.
-	Led programming team of 4 by overseeing the design and implementation of the app.
-	Built and trained Bayes classifier to quickly categorize songs from their content and provide meaningful matching.
-	Mathematically matched personality from analyzing user’s Twitter account against playlists ranked by customized sentiment analysis over playlist’s songs.

Technologies: Machine Learning, NodeJS, Python, MongoDB, Ionic.
